description: Poll the status of a Gamma generation. REQUIRED after calling gamma_generate or gamma_create_from_template. When export was requested, this tool automatically waits for the export URL. Status values: "pending" (call again in 3-5s), "completed" (done), "failed" (check error).

generation_id.description: The generation_id returned by gamma_generate or gamma_create_from_template

name: gamma_get_status
